state.context: You are scoring WallStreetBets retail sentiment as a CONTRARIAN mania meter for a paper-trading scan. WSB speaks in irony, sarcasm, and gallows humor — read tone, not just keywords. Euphoria means crowded-trade caution, never a buy signal. Some sources are stale-dated; weigh recency. Answer only from the sources below.

sources.title: Sentiment Analysis: IWM
sources.snippet: Sentiment scores 58/100 (Neutral-Bullish), reflecting a cautiously constructive but unconfirmed tilt across news, social, analyst, institutional, and options/short interest dimensions. Social media sentiment is moderate and present but structurally lower than it would be for a high-profile single-stock name — IWM is an institutional instrument and does not generate the viral retail intensity of individual equities.

sources.title: The IWM Small-Cap Trade Is Built On A Narrative That Already Died
sources.snippet: I rate the IWM ETF as a Sell. The rally has already disconnected from the catalyst that justified it... If you believe small caps deserve exposure, the entry point should come when the debt overhang actually compresses - not before it.

sources.title: iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) Draws Large Weekly Inflow as Small-Cap Exposure Gains
sources.snippet: IWM recorded an estimated inflow of approximately $2.4 billion, reflecting a 3.1% increase in units outstanding. For an ETF of IWM's size and liquidity, that is a notable move and suggests renewed demand for broad small-cap exposure.

sources.title: Risk-On In Small-Caps After iShares Russell 2000 ETF Breaks Out
sources.snippet: The breakout in IWM and relative strength displayed versus other indexes and medium to large-cap stocks is a clear shift in sentiment and one to pay close attention to.

lean.instructions: What is the directional lean of WSB chatter on this ticker across these sources?

criteria.bullish: Chatter clearly leans bullish: more optimism, upside targets, and call-side energy than fear.
criteria.bearish: Chatter clearly leans bearish: more fear, downside talk, and put-side hedging than optimism.
criteria.mixed: Genuinely two-sided: bullish and bearish voices both present, no clear majority.
criteria.quiet: Too little real chatter to call a lean: stale, off-topic, or thin results.

conviction.instructions: How intense is the WSB attention on this ticker right now?
criteria: No meaningful attention: quiet or stale results only
Light chatter: routine mentions, no excitement
Moderate buzz: elevated mentions, real debate
Heavy buzz: surging mentions, strong directional energy

euphoria.instructions: Is WSB euphoric about this ticker — crowded-trade territory?

criteria.true: Euphoric: pile-on, moon-talk, mania-like. Read as crowded-trade caution.
criteria.false: Not euphoric: measured, mixed, or quiet chatter.

surface.instructions: Is this sentiment development worth surfacing to Mark in the morning briefing?

criteria.true: Yes: new, strong, or surprising enough to earn a line in the brief.
criteria.false: No: routine or thin. Keep it in the audit file only.
